messages:
olivia: Quick a11y pass on Console dashboards — ran keyboard + NVDA sweep on staging. Found a few actionable things. TL;DR: contrast issues on muted tokens, missing focus for custom dropdowns, toasts not announced, tables missing scope, chip buttons have no aria-label. kevin: Thanks — can you list the pages/components? I can start small fixes. olivia: Pages: Project list, Model versions table, Alerts drawer, Topbar user menu. Components: chips (owner/team), token usage badge (low contrast #6B7280 on #FFFFFF), custom select (div role=listbox) no focusable child, toast banner uses visually-hidden only but not aria-live. sarah: Prioritize anything blocking keyboard nav or screen readers for alerts and topbar before next release. mike: Repro steps for select: Tab into dropdown, list opens, but focus stays on trigger and arrow keys don't move to options. NVDA reads 'Group' for chips instead of 'chips' and doesn't announce count. kevin: For focus, we can add tabindex to options and role=option. Example: ```
Option A
``` Then on open shift focus with JS: options[0].focus(). olivia: Also recommend visible focus ring consistent with design tokens (2px outline, color token --focus). Contrast: token text should be at least 4.5:1 for body text. The usage badge is only 3:1. kevin: I'll whip up a small CSS patch and add unit tests for keyboard nav. Link PR when ready. a11y-bot: Automated audit results: 8 failures, 15 warnings. Failing: color-contrast, bypass-blocks, aria-allowed-attr. sarah: Can we add an a11y smoke test to CI that'll run a11y checks on /console/* pages? We should block merges if new contrast regressions appear. mike: QA can add NVDA + VoiceOver checklist for the release and test the Alerts drawer. kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abcd1234 — fixes select focus + aria on chips, adds aria-live="polite" to toast. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-234--console.staging.redwood.ai olivia: Nice. Two followups: 1) Add skip-to-main link for keyboard users. 2) Table headers need scope="col" and proper elements not divs. kevin: Agree. I'll include skip link and update table markup. sarah: timeline? we need this in canary next week. kevin: I'll aim for EOD tomorrow for the select/toast fixes, then table markup after. mike: I'll run regression with NVDA once PR merged. olivia: Thanks everyone. I'll add these to the accessibility board and assign issues. :sparkles:
